items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bob Wilbur, is he with you? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I had, uh, Harry Green on clarinet...

ctx.x: So, uh, Bill Davis' wife run up, and when she found out, she says, oh, my Bill's got to work with Brunus. So, uh, Bobby Hackett was staying at the bar, and we were talking Condon, Pesky, and so Condon says, well, he says, I got to do something I never did in my life. I hate to do it. I got to fire two guys. I think it was Brad Gowns and, uh, Max Kaminsky. So, uh, he says, I got to put Barnum and Bailey in there. So Bobby Hackett says, look, no matter who you're putting in, as long as you do business, he says,…
Bob Wilbur, is he with you?

No, I had, uh, Harry Green on clarinet, and his drummer that plays like Buddy Rich, what's his name? Well, I just can't remember. Anyway, I'm sure you work all over there. Most of the guys, uh, most of the guys were at the, uh, Rhymes. So we came out here, and we stayed, uh, we were supposed to be there two weeks, and we stayed six months. And at the weekends, it was beginning to pick up mouth-to-mouth publicity. So then I got an offer to go into the Blue Note. And just then, the band quit me, went back to New…
